close_reason: NOT A BUG: RFC 8620 §5.4 IS the copy method spec (not /changes). It says accountId 'MUST be different to fromAccountId'. The code is correct and the citation is correct.
description: email.rs:1163 rejects fromAccountId==accountId with the comment 'RFC 8620 §5.4: fromAccountId MUST differ from accountId'. RFC 8620 §5.4 is the /changes spec — it says nothing about copy. RFC 8620 §6.3 (the actual copy spec) describes copying 'from one Account to another' but contains no MUST requiring different accounts. A client trying to clone an email to a different mailbox in the same account (using Email/copy rather than Email/set) gets an invalidArguments error with no spec basis. This will generate issue reports when users try same-account copy workflows.
title: Email/copy rejects same-account copy with wrong RFC citation
